scope: Argo-managed Trustee and encrypted MEV on the existing dev SEV-SNP host. Sanitized consolidation of the owned-image qualification, original-image restoration and administrator audit.

originalOperatorRestoration.scope: Boot, readiness, attested key release and isolation. Original operator authentication and business logic were not tested.

nativePolicyEvaluation.engine: Regorus against exact live guest policies and owner-approved resource policy

administratorAudit.liveProbeQualification: The live unapproved guest changed both startup options and workload policy. The isolated same-VM/different-workload case was checked by native policy evaluation, not a separate live guest.

limits: Identical approved instances can qualify; instance binding is deferred.
VM replacement loses Trustee state and requires owner verification and reprovisioning; durable recovery is deferred.
Cluster and host administrators can deny availability.
Trusted workstation provisioning credentials and retained migration keys are outside the cluster-administrator boundary; original-image-owner-exclusive custody is not established.
No automatic certificate renewal, rollback protection or continuous attestation freshness.
Targeted checks do not replace independent image provenance verification or a production security review.
privacy: Raw reports, chip identity, node names, addresses, image references, resource names, credentials and private keys omitted.
